origin: Deterministic 640 by 360 production frame, row-major first stage-15 sky failure at radius 200. No random seed.
reason: An absolute unit floor in the Mino arrival bracket stopping test left ordinary far-sky paths above the angular uncertainty threshold. The test compares the repaired sky direction with the binary64 quadrature reference on quantized inputs. Critical-ray acceptance is unchanged.

halfPeriodCancellation.origin: First radius-200 stage-15 failure after the precision selector widened to 4%; same deterministic frame and runtime.
halfPeriodCancellation.reason: The Abel addition identity underestimated cancellation by using the rounded H magnitude instead of its original term magnitudes. The local half-period seed remains subject to forward-path bracketing.

precisionSelection.reason: The positive-g3, small-modulus ray was unnecessarily selected for integer preparation; the prior path reported a sky/equator boundary tie. Native preparation resolves the independently checked sky branch within the unchanged direction target.
